en.start_text: Hello! I'm a post bot. I can post your messages to your channel. Click /help for more information and setup guide.
en.help_text: If you wanna use me, invite me to your channel or group with admin rights. After that click /options and follow guide to set your channel.
en.set_group:
1. Invite me to your channel or group with admin rights.
2. Forward a message from your channel or group to this chat.
en.set_group_success: Success! Now you can post messages to your group!
en.set_group_failed: It's seems not be a channel or group message. Please, send me a forward message from your channel or group again.
